title: P0.91: Portable Context Account Scan UI Budget
description: Prevent UI calls to PortableContextService.current_package(refresh=false) from building the full portable context and scanning browser/account resources synchronously.
reason: Live shortcut proof after P0.90 removed the objective_repository SQLite stall, but a new 39649ms ui_event_loop_stall showed PortableContextService.current_package -> build_package -> canonical_work_queue -> ControlMasterService.current_state -> account_resource_scanner.scan_browser_sessions -> os.stat on browser profiles in the main UI thread.
next_action: Merge P0.91, update the desktop shortcut runtime, open IABV from the shortcut, and verify EvolutionCenter/dashboard portable context reads use cached/stale package plus background refresh without UI stalls.
resume_hint: UI callers use current_package(refresh=false, allow_stale=true). PortableContextService returns cached/latest or a lightweight UNRESOLVED package and schedules portable_context_background_refresh_finished asynchronously. refresh=true still performs the full build for explicit background/service callers.
